_source.title: 757-200 Flight Crew Operations Manual
_source.provenance: user-supplied PDF; not included in repository
_source.extraction: PyMuPDF positional text extraction; no interpolation; rendered-page visual checks; see docs/FCOM_757_NORDWIND.md

scope.missingCellsPolicy: listed explicitly, not zero and not interpolated

packets.fleetMapping: correlation of explicit engine, wing and mass-unit effectivity; PI packet itself has model/engine header

conditions.speedSchedule: FMC optimum holding: higher of maximum endurance and maneuvering speed
conditions.temperature: not separately specified on the holding page

conditions.boundary: top of descent through straight-in approach, gear down and landing flaps at outer marker

conditions.temperatureInput: TAT, not ISA deviation or static air temperature

apuFuelIncrement.scope: aircraft total increment; all-engine text explicitly refers to this table in engine-inoperative text
includes: additional main-engine fuel from APU door drag

conditions.pageFootnote: *Denotes altitude thrust limited in level flight, 100 fpm residual rate of climb.
conditions.asteriskMeaning: thrust limited in level flight; explanatory text permits max-cruise thrust at 0 fpm OR max-climb thrust at 100 fpm
